_doc: Engine schema for Cozy Chores "Open House" project "movein" (GDD 4, 6, 7, 13). Built by cozy-chores-tools/build-projects.mjs from farin-lxd's content-chores-movein.json; words come from content/movein.json by line role (a role 'x' in station 's' = the line whose id ends in '.s.x', or the full id). Stand-in art lives in "art" until art/manifest.json lists the real file.

objects._doc: farin-lxd 2026-10-29 (lines obj.movein.*): target words + tr / fa / en glosses.

co-tea-table.name: kitchen table edge (foreground)
co-tea-table.desc: The near edge of the kitchen table across the whole frame: a straight wooden top with its back edge line, then the front.

plate-flat1-door-wide.name: Flat 1 landing, wide
plate-flat1-door-wide.desc: The first-floor landing of number 12: the green door of Flat 1 (a cut-out), a window onto the harbour with morning sun, removal boxes stacked by the wall, a pot plant. Morning light.

plate-flat1-boxes-pov.name: Flat 1 living room, three boxes
plate-flat1-boxes-pov.desc: Eye level on the empty living room floor: wooden boards, a sunny window behind; three removal boxes stand on the floor (the boxes, their tape and what is inside are cut-outs).

plate-flat1-kitchen-shelf.name: Flat 1 kitchen, the shelf
plate-flat1-kitchen-shelf.desc: Two-shot in the small kitchen: an empty wall shelf at eye level, tiles, a window; Leyla stands on the right (cut-out). An open box on the floor bottom left. Noon light.

plate-flat1-bedroom-top.name: Flat 1 bedroom, from above
plate-flat1-bedroom-top.desc: Straight down on the small bedroom: the bed in the middle, the top edge is the wall (pictures hang there), a bedside table to the left of the bed, a window on the right wall, sun on the floor. Afternoon light.

plate-flat1-tea-two.name: Flat 1 kitchen table, tea
plate-flat1-tea-two.desc: Two-shot across the kitchen table at golden hour: Leyla (cut-out) sits opposite with tea glasses (Tabriz style) and a sugar bowl; the window glows gold behind her.

plate-flat1-wide.name: Flat 1, wide (album)
plate-flat1-wide.desc: Flat 1 finished: lamp next to the bed, the photo where you put it, cups on the shelf. Golden light. (Used blurred behind the A1 recap.)

co-photo-frame.name: family photo
co-photo-frame.desc: Leyla’s mum and dad in Tabriz, framed (no faces needed close up)

plate-flat1-sill-close.name: The bedroom windowsill, close
plate-flat1-sill-close.desc: Close on the sunny bedroom windowsill: a geranium in a terracotta pot on the right (part of the plate), the harbour blurred outside. The watering can, the wet soil and the paper tag are cut-outs. Afternoon light.

plate-flat1-bedroom-nobed.name: Flat 1 bedroom from above, no bed
plate-flat1-bedroom-nobed.desc: The same room as plate-flat1-bedroom-top with the same light and framing, but the floor is empty where the bed was (the bed is a cut-out at B1 and C1): the top edge is the wall, a bedside table on the left, a window on the right wall. Afternoon light.

co-flat1-bowl.name: bowl
co-flat1-bowl.desc: a plain soup bowl from Leyla’s set (matches co-cup); A2 and up: 4 bowls go on the counter

co-flat1-counter.name: kitchen counter under the shelf
co-flat1-counter.desc: a wooden worktop running under the shelf, seen from the front; the target for the bowls (A2 and up); empty, room for 4 bowls

co-watering-can.name: small watering can
co-watering-can.desc: a small tin watering can, tilted slightly, held from the right (Mrs Bell’s present for Leyla)

co-soil-wet.name: wet soil in the pot
co-soil-wet.desc: darker wet soil, sits on top of the pot in the plate; it grows as the learner pours

co-plant-tag.name: paper tag on the pot
co-plant-tag.desc: a small paper tag tied to the pot: “Flat 1 · Mondays” (CZ12 curio)

co-bed.name: Leyla’s bed, from above
co-bed.desc: a single bed seen straight down: white sheet, pillow at the top; a cut-out so it can slide (B1 under the window, C1 to the far wall)
